read.thesis: Nike cut supply in Sportswear, Jordan and China and guided FY27 revenue down high single digits with EBIT falling faster; Pace savings of $2.5B back-end loaded to FY29-30.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue high single-digit decline
triggers.quote: For fiscal '27, we currently expect revenues to decline in the high single-digit range.

triggers.label: Deliberate supply cuts; Dunk down ~50%
triggers.quote: We will continue to take actions to reduce supply across key parts of the marketplace

triggers.label: EBIT to fall faster than revenue
triggers.quote: We currently expect EBIT to decline by a greater percentage than revenue.

triggers.label: Aged sportswear sold below expectations
triggers.quote: some aged, higher volume, sportswear footwear sold through below expectations

triggers.label: Performance up high single digits
triggers.quote: if you were to isolate our NIKE Performance business, it was up high single digits this quarter

guidance.quote: we currently expect revenues to decline in the high single-digit range.
we currently expect fiscal '27 adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $1.15 to $1.35.
We expect Pace will deliver approximately $2.5 billion in savings.

guidance.value: ~400 bps from EMEA Cyber Week and NA sell-in
guidance.quote: These 2 items will represent a headwind of approximately 400 basis points to revenues in the second quarter.
under all scenarios, we have support for maintaining and ultimately growing the dividend over time.

red_flags.label: Dividend ratio over 100% of guidance midpoint
red_flags.quote: I think the dividend ratio is over 100%.

red_flags.label: China revenue to worsen for rest of year
red_flags.quote: the guidance range that I just provided to you assumes that China actually gets worse from a revenue perspective for the balance of this year

red_flags.label: Pain to bleed into FY28
red_flags.quote: that's going to be through the balance of this year and probably bleed in a little bit into fiscal '28 as well.

evasions.quote: we're probably not going to provide guidance specifically for gross margin.

evasions.topic: Pace payback timing and dividend coverage
evasions.quote: So why don't we hold that question, we'll come back to it at Investor Day
we're not going to give guidance, obviously, by region.
